shortDescription: US President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Monday ​to expand access to tax-exempt diesel.Trump signed the order on stage during a rally in Nebraska, saying the directive will waive off-road requirement and allow anyone to purchase tax-free so-called red dye diesel.
